title: Pleasantly Vanilla! (Best Looks)
description: This version of Pleasantly Vanilla adds shaders, more textures, and improved animations! it also includes all the features from the original and more chunks edition!
body:
This indenpendent version of Pleasantly Vanilla adds many new animations, textures, and shader packs. With these new features you can look to expect enhanced opstimized visuals while still keeping the soul and beauty of minecraft itself. However it is more suitable for high range systems. This version is compatible with the original version and the more chunks edition, meaning if you install a multiplayer mod you and your friends should NOT run into any issues!

(_**high range systems reccomended**_) (_**4gb ram minimum, 8gb ram reccomended**_) (_**im not resposible for crashes regarding the limits of your own system**_)

Please contact me through my discord if you have any issues. I will make sure to get back to you as soon as I can!

Monthly Updates!!
